description: Bring your Looki memories into Codex for personalized answers grounded in your real-world context. Browse moments by date, search memories by meaning, open a specific moment and its media, revisit AI-generated highlights, or check the latest realtime event when available. Temporary media links are treated as private, short-lived data.

defaultPrompt: Review my day and summarize the key moments, activities, and themes.
Recall my most relevant recent memories and organize them by topic.
What is happening around me right now based on my latest Looki event?
